content.text: Check covers 2025 files, including the new one. Passed.

I copied `inbox/2025-12.csv` into `data/` and committed it as `6befab7` with the message "2025-12: add rows".

I ran `scripts/check.sh` before committing and it printed OK. It checks every `data/2025-*.csv` file, so the new one was included. It checks that each row has the same number of fields as the header, and nothing else.

The check script also says the nightly import only reloads the month the commit message starts with. This message starts with "2025-12", so tonight's import should pick up the new file.

The original is still in `inbox/`. I didn't delete it because you didn't ask me to.
